div.div:
فَتْحَى Gain, profit, or increase obtained in traffic; syn. رِبْحٌ; [so accord. to the L; accord. to the copies of the K, erroneously, رِيحٌ i. e. “ wind; ”] mentioned by Az, on the authority of Ibn-Buzurj: a poet says, “أَكُلُّهُمُ لَا بَارَكَ ٱللّٰهُ فِيهِمُ
إِذَا ذُكِرَتْ فَتْحَى مِنَ البَيْعِ عَاجِبُ
” [Are all of them, (may God not bless them,) when gain arising from selling is mentioned, in a state of wonder?]. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
